territorial_scope.description: Applies within the State's jurisdiction; Part 2 defines when media service providers and online services are under the jurisdiction of the State.

evidence.quote: Meaning of “under the jurisdiction of the State”: providers of video-sharing platform services

summary.short: Amends the Broadcasting Act 2009 and establishes Coimisiún na Meán to regulate broadcasting, on-demand audiovisual media and online safety content, with obligations on providers and administrative sanctions. Dated 10 December 2022.
summary.long: Amends the Broadcasting Act 2009 and establishes Coimisiún na Meán to regulate broadcasting, audiovisual on-demand media and certain online services. Part 2 changes definitions and the meaning of 'under the jurisdiction of the State' for media service providers, video-sharing platform services and other relevant online services. Part 3 establishes the Commission; Part 16 dissolves the Broadcasting Authority of Ireland and transfers its functions, staff, property and liabilities. Part 4 requires a register of audiovisual on-demand media providers. Part 5 imposes duties, codes and rules on media service providers and sound broadcasters; Parts 6 to 10 amend related Broadcasting Act provisions. Part 11 regulates content on relevant online services and harmful online content on designated online services. Part 12 provides investigations, sanctions and oral hearings, including administrative financial sanctions. Parts 13 and 14 cover a journalistic practices scheme and support for European works, funded partly by a levy. Part 17 amends other enactments, including the Referendum Act 1998 and the Electoral Reform Act 2022. Only the contents, long title and preamble were supplied; operative section text is not in the document.
